items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Another name that I can't recall of was Crusto. He was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: That was a man made up of I think some of Mineta's relatives, some of his older group. Some names that I don't even remember. Another name that I can't recall of was Crusto. He was a trumpet player. I think he was the one that had taught Perez if I'm not mistaken. Crusto and then there's a fellow by the name of Boasso. He was the old baritone in the area. I also worked with the old, well they were about in the same area. Like Vic Gasper and his brother. Yes. Old Gasper. George Fields. He was, I think he's dead…
